name: Discontinuity-aware Gaussian Splatting
definition: A framework that equips Gaussian Splatting with discontinuity rendering ability by 'pre-scissoring' projected Gaussians along boundaries represented by cubic Bézier curves before rendering, using a Bézier-boundary gradient approximation strategy to maintain differentiability during learning.
summary: Discontinuity-aware Gaussian Splatting renders sharp boundaries by modeling them as cubic Bézier curves and applying pre-scissoring, unlike standard methods that blur such features.
